other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Meghalaya
Applicant must be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture
Applicant must own or lease land of at least 0.2 hectares
Benefits are allocated on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis
benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy on planting materials, polypipes and construction of soakage tanks as a one‑year financial assistance.
